## `client.search`

{class}`~plone_client.managers.search.SearchManager`.

Catalog queries through `@search`.

### `client.search.search`

One page of results.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.search.SearchManager.search`.

Calls `GET /news/@search` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/searching.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.search.search("/news", portal_type="News Item", b_size=2)
```
````

````{tab-item} Command line
:sync: cli

```shell
plone-client search /news -t "News Item" --limit 2 -f @id,title
```

```json
[
  {
    "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/release-6-2",
    "title": "Release 6.2 is out"
  },
  {
    "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/release-party",
    "title": "Release party in Brasília"
  }
]
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/news/@search?portal_type=News+Item&b_size=2 HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET 'http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/news/@search?portal_type=News+Item&b_size=2' -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/release-6-2",
      "review_state": "published",
      "title": "Release 6.2 is out"
    },
    {
      "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/release-party",
      "review_state": "private",
      "title": "Release party in Brasília"
    }
  ],
  "items_total": 5
}
```

This shows only `items`, `items_total`. This shows only `@id`, `title`, `review_state` of each entry.

#### Sort, and ask for more metadata

`query` takes options of a catalog index, and `metadata_fields` adds columns to each result.

Calls `GET /@search` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/searching.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.search.search(
    query={"created": {"query": "2000-01-01", "range": "min"}},
    portal_type="Document",
    sort_on="sortable_title",
    metadata_fields="UID",
)
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/@search?created.query=2000-01-01&created.range=min&portal_type=Document&sort_on=sortable_title&metadata_fields=UID HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET 'http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@search?created.query=2000-01-01&created.range=min&portal_type=Document&sort_on=sortable_title&metadata_fields=UID' -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "UID": "3788c6ac13e749709aa4f2fb771821ce",
      "title": "About"
    },
    {
      "UID": "4bf216176ffc4aa1ac76407db4d0202a",
      "title": "Media"
    }
  ],
  "items_total": 5
}
```

This shows only `items`, `items_total`. This shows only `title`, `UID` of each entry. This shows 2 of 5 entries.

## `client.querystring`

{class}`~plone_client.managers.search.QuerystringManager`.

Collection-style queries through `@querystring-search`.

### `client.querystring.config`

Indexes, operators and sort options the querystring accepts.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.search.QuerystringManager.config`.

Calls `GET /@querystring` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/querystring.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
sorted(client.querystring.config()["sortable_indexes"])[:3]
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/@querystring HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@querystring -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
[
  "Creator",
  "created",
  "effective"
]
```

### `client.querystring.search`

Run a querystring query.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.search.QuerystringManager.search`.

Calls `POST /@querystring-search` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/querystringsearch.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.querystring.search(
    [
        {
            "i": "portal_type",
            "o": "plone.app.querystring.operation.selection.any",
            "v": ["News Item"],
        }
    ],
    sort_on="sortable_title",
    b_size=2,
)
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
POST /Plone/++api++/@querystring-search HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=

{
  "query": [
    {
      "i": "portal_type",
      "o": "plone.app.querystring.operation.selection.any",
      "v": [
        "News Item"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "sort_on": "sortable_title",
  "b_size": 2
}
```

```shell
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@querystring-search -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'content-type: application/json' -u admin:admin --data-raw '{"query":[{"i":"portal_type","o":"plone.app.querystring.operation.selection.any","v":["News Item"]}],"sort_on":"sortable_title","b_size":2}'
```
````
`````

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/old-announcement",
      "title": "Old announcement"
    },
    {
      "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/release-6-2",
      "title": "Release 6.2 is out"
    }
  ],
  "items_total": 5
}
```

This shows only `items`, `items_total`. This shows only `@id`, `title` of each entry.
